doctor.name: Dr. Maanvita Kumari
doctor.bio: Trusted family physician with over 14 years of clinical experience from Maulana Azad Medical College. Committed to evidence-based, compassionate care for adults, seniors, and chronic lifestyle disorders.

hero.headline: Trusted Family Medicine & Chronic Care in Noida
hero.subtitle: Dedicated consultations with zero rushed queues. Focused on diabetes, hypertension, seasonal fevers, and personalized adult healthcare.

services.title: Diabetes Management
services.description: Comprehensive blood glucose monitoring, HbA1c review, insulin adjustment, and lifestyle plan.

services.title: Hypertension Care
services.description: BP titration, ECG evaluation, cardiovascular risk assessment, and medication reviews.

services.title: Seasonal Fevers & Infections
services.description: Rapid diagnosis and evidence-based protocols for Dengue, Typhoid, Viral flu, and malaria.

services.title: Thyroid Disorders
services.description: Evaluation and management of Hypo/Hyperthyroidism, TSH balancing, and dietary guidance.

services.title: Geriatric Health Care
services.description: Specialized healthcare for senior citizens focusing on multi-morbidity and mobility wellness.

services.title: Preventive Executive Health
services.description: Comprehensive annual physical examinations, lipid profiles, and early detection screens.
